listing.name: NEON's ship pack (v3.0.5.8)
listing.summary: A Vanilla+ Ship Pack which adds a curated selection of vessels to the main factions of the sector, alongside adding onto existing vanilla exploration content.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a curated selection of new ships to major factions and expands vanilla exploration content.

description: Introduces new vessels for main factions while enhancing existing exploration features. Includes rebalanced ship stats, new hulls like the Legion and Dominator, and updated sprites for various classes.

changelog.3.0.3: -Version 3.0.3 - Implemented Incursor, Dominator (LP), and Hammerhead (LP) class vessels. Removed missile autoforge, advanced targeting core from Nemetor and Templar class ships. Nerfed stat spread of the Templar class. Removed Thegualsno class reversed Onslaught battleship. Implemented new sprite and ship system for the Nemetor class, implemented new sprite for the Regal class.
changelog.3.0.2:
-Version 3.0.2 - Implemented Iliad and Culmination class vessels, implemented new sprites for the Grox/Goblin Mk.II, Luminance, and Legate class vessels. Fixed bug where (PR) style hull modules counted alongside the base DP of the hull. Added tips. Adjusted some stats.
 A little update in-between the larger things I'm working on for the mod.
changelog.3.0.1:
-Version 3.0.1 - Hotfixes for minor issues like modules being selectable, and misaligned weapon mounts
 ^ Should be save compatible with 3.0.0
